RAF Officer Faces Scrutiny Over Alleged Social Media Post

An Assistant Commandant of the Rapid Action Force (RAF), Sonia Sahrawat, is reportedly facing potential action following an alleged Instagram story. The controversy arose during a protest by the Congress (referred to as 'Cockroach Janata Party' in one report) at Delhi's Jantar Mantar, with the post allegedly containing a sarcastic remark about 'floundering cockroaches'.
